note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: New hires take too long to become productive. Our onboarding takes 10 weeks on average and we want to cut it.

answers.common.decision: Whether to redesign onboarding; the head of people decides.
answers.common.audience: The head of people and team leads.
answers.common.materials: We hire about 60 people a year. New hires who had a buddy reached full productivity in 7 weeks.
answers.people-hr.process: Onboarding for all new hires, using our learning system.
answers.people-hr.decider: The head of people approves program changes.
